pkg.ambiguous_text: This package cannot be imported as it stands. The objects marked in red changed both here and in the package, have unpublished changes here, or have tables here that differ from their design. Resolve those here, then import the package again.
pkg.apply_failed: The package could not be applied.
pkg.apply_hint: Objects are applied in order: applications, forms (published through the normal migration plan), then templates and profiles. If one fails, nothing after it is applied and that form stays as it was.
pkg.applying_text: The package is being applied in the background. This page updates by itself.
pkg.confirm_blocking_desc: For example, making a field required while some records have no value in it.
pkg.confirm_destructive_desc: Fields or sections the package no longer has are removed with their stored values. A snapshot is taken first.
pkg.dependencies_hint: The application of each form, the forms it links to and the templates its rules use are added for you. Roles, departments and people are matched by key in the other environment.

pkg.diff_part.subject: Subject
pkg.empty_text: Export a package to move configuration to another environment, or import one exported elsewhere.
pkg.export_failed: The package could not be exported.
pkg.export_intro: Choose what to take to the other environment. A form is exported as it is published, with its workflow, notification rules and access.
pkg.exported: The package was exported and downloaded.
pkg.load_failed: The packages could not be loaded.
pkg.missing_dependency: Needs something that is neither here nor in the package
pkg.missing_subjects: These do not exist here, so grants and rules that name them will be left out: {list}
pkg.name: Name
pkg.packages_intro: A package is a file with the chosen objects and everything they need. Importing one first compares it with this environment; you decide what happens to each object before anything changes.
pkg.report_hint: Each object in the package, compared with the one here.
pkg.reports_empty_text: Upload a package to see how it differs from this environment.
pkg.reports_intro: Compare a package, or a full export of another environment, with this one without importing anything.
pkg.schema_hint: Reconcile these in the Schema explorer before importing over them.
pkg.schema_title: Tables that differ from their design
pkg.state_hint.changed_here: Changed here since it was last imported
pkg.state_hint.changed_in_both: Changed here and in the package since it was last imported
pkg.state_hint.key_taken: Another object here uses this key
pkg.state_hint.schema_drift: Its tables here differ from its design
